# MUSH story art handoff

**Status: proposal, not built. No art has been generated by this story package.** This is an early concept and modelling handoff for Agent C. IDs and character heights match [story_manifest.json](story_manifest.json); personalities and living arrangements match [CHARACTERS.md](CHARACTERS.md). Dimensions below are proposed art dimensions, not measurements of existing Godot meshes, approved colliders or a change to the runtime world.

The source reference is the user-supplied `design-reference/mush-concept-1.png`. Its useful language is painterly fantasy with readable organic silhouettes, warm amber interiors, muted violet fungi, soft timber and stone, fine cared-for craft, and an intimate home against an immense watershed. **Turnaround sheets deliberately replace its dramatic sunset, mist and cast shadows with flat neutral backing and soft even light.** Keep subtle painted form shading and material colour; do not bake sunset highlights, fog, bloom or occlusion into a model reference. Nothing is creepy, diseased, skeletal or weapon-like.

Each prompt below is self-contained. Supply the user reference when producing art, but the written description must remain usable on its own. Produce separate consistent front, three-quarter, side and back views of the same design, at matching scale without perspective exaggeration. For flat objects, “side” means its thickness and “back” the reverse face. For architecture, use front, three-quarter, side and rear elevations, with a separate overhead view only where requested. **Plain flat `#d9d9d9`, soft even light, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no logo, no watermark.** Dimension notes remain in the handoff rather than being rendered on the sheet. No invented lettering, imitation scripts, sacred motifs, national costume, real-person likenesses or brands.

The existing cream player with rounded ears and tucked round tail is unchanged. Do not generate a replacement mascot, recolour the player to match Brindle, give the player new clothes, or infer a new player size from these NPC sheets. Use the existing model/reference later if a scale comparison needs the player. Keep companion scale real: Plink is 0.09 m high and Nuzzle 0.12 m; enlarge their *sheet framing*, not their bodies.

Heights include head/ears in a neutral pose and exclude removable props. Length/width supplements disambiguate non-bipedal bodies. Suggested home entries and paths are visual space reservations, not traversal acceptance. All story NPCs, inventory, loan objects, quests and settlement interactions remain future systems. Keepsakes are neither seed unlocks nor newly placeable furniture. Exact dimensions of props may be refined after handling tests while their recognisable shapes stay consistent.

**Prompt:** Create a four-view character turnaround of Brindle, an original valley woodland creature, 0.95 m high, in the MUSH concept-1 painterly fantasy language: soft organic forms, warm craft materials, restrained brush texture and inviting detail. Brindle is a neighbour, not the existing cream player; do not use a cream body or alter the player.
